body: Owner asked 2026-11-11. Every source build says 0.1.0, so a stale build cannot be told from a fresh one. Version becomes 0.1.0+<sha>[.dirty] (semver build metadata), stamped at build time. -v and -V print it. sati doctor says when the source checkout has newer code than the build.

completion.summary: `sati --version` prints `0.1.0+<sha7>[.dirty]`, fixed at build time by a tsdown define; `-v` and `-V` print the same; the MCP server reports it. `sati doctor` adds a `build` check in a source checkout: fails when `packages/` or `pnpm-lock.yaml` changed between the stamped commit and HEAD. Turbo cache is off for the CLI build so the stamp is never stale. Tests: version.test.ts (flags, stamp equals HEAD, build check in temp git repos).

title: Build stamp in the version: sati --version shows the commit it was built from; -v and -V; doctor says when the build is behind
